name: Aadhaar Card
guidance: You can download your e-Aadhaar from the official UIDAI portal or visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center.

name: Bank Passbook
guidance: Open a savings account at any nationalized or scheduled bank. Ensure it is seeded with your Aadhaar.

name: Land Record / 7/12 Extract
guidance: Obtain a verified copy of your land records (like 7/12 or 8A extract) from your local Tehsil office or state land records portal.

name: Income Certificate
guidance: Apply for an income certificate at your local Tehsildar office, CSC (Common Service Center), or state e-District portal.

name: Caste Certificate
guidance: Apply at the local Tehsildar or Sub-Divisional Magistrate office using your state's e-District portal.

name: Farmer Registration Certificate
aliases: crop sowing certificate/registration on state procurement portal
guidance: Register on your state's Department of Agriculture portal or procurement portal.

name: Ration Card
guidance: Apply through the Food and Civil Supplies Department of your state.

name: Address Proof
guidance: Can be Aadhaar, Voter ID, Ration Card, or utility bills.
